items.title: MIRA miniaturised space-imaging system receives an Indian patent
items.text: Hyderabad-based EON Space Labs received an Indian patent for MIRA, a compact telescope-based imaging system designed for space applications. The system weighs about 502 g.

items.title: Scientists observe a predicted solar motion linked to solar flares
items.text: Science News reports that scientists have observed a long-predicted motion on the Sun that may help explain how explosive solar flares are triggered.

items.title: India’s women’s compound archery team equals the world record
items.text: Jyothi Surekha Vennam, Chikitha Taniparthi and Prithika Pradeep scored 238–234 against China at the 2026 Asian Games, equalling the world, Asian and Games records.

items.title: US forces complete withdrawal from Iraq
items.text: Reports on 1 October 2026 said US forces completed their withdrawal from Iraq after more than two decades, ending the US-led anti-IS mission there.

items.title: Shubman Gill scores 223 in India’s record ODI chase
items.text: Shubman Gill scored an unbeaten 223 as India chased 406 against the West Indies. It was reported as India’s highest successful men’s ODI run chase.

items.title: India reaches 60 medals at the Asian Games
items.text: India’s tally reached 60 medals at the 2026 Asian Games, including 10 gold, 21 silver and 29 bronze, according to reports on 1 October.
